; REQ: LANG-621 LANG-622
#lang racket
(provide greet)

(struct point (x y) #:transparent)

(define (greet name)
  (match name
    ["world" (printf "Hello, ~a!\n" name)]
    [_ (displayln "who?")]))

(for/list ([i (in-range 3)])
  (* i i))

(define-syntax-rule (unless* c body) (if c (void) body))
(greet "world")
(first (list #t #f 'sym))
